svg.title: ESP8266 air quality monitor wiring diagram
svg.desc: Wiring diagram showing 12V adapter feeding a buck converter that powers the Wemos D1 Mini, a dust sensor, and a NeoPixel LED at 5V, while the 4-wire PC fan runs from raw 12V with its PWM line driven by GPIO5.
svg.text: Tach (Pin 3) left floating · all grounds tied together · 470 Ω in series with NeoPixel DIN
